pulse.text: **OpenAI's Astra just got repriced hard.** Kalshi's ladder now puts the delayed model at **70% before Oct 1, down from 95%**, and only 26% before Sep 1 against 76% at the last sweep, after OpenAI told Axios it cannot rule out critical cyber capabilities and would slow the model down; Polymarket's Sep 30 leg eased more gently, to **82% from 88%**. Nothing has shipped since Aug 7 — xAI's own docs still top out at grok-4.5 and the newest tracked model is still Grok Imagine Image 2.0 — but **Grok 4.6 now prices at 88% before Aug 15** on Kalshi after its Aug 9 leg collapsed to 1% from 43%, so xAI's next text model reads as days away, not weeks. What Astra gave up flowed to Anthropic: Claude's year-end LMArena #1 line climbed to **68.4% from 64.6%**, its best-coding-model line to 62% from 60%, and Polymarket still holds Anthropic at 92% for end-of-August with **Claude Opus 5 unchanged at #1** on a 61 AA-Index. GPT-6 firmed at the medium horizon, with Kalshi's before-Oct-1 leg up to **65% from 57%** even as Polymarket's Aug 31 leg eased to 14%, while Gemini 3.5 Pro stays split — 58% on Polymarket, 53% on Kalshi — for an Aug 31 arrival. Watch the week of Aug 10: Qwen3.8-Max's open weights are due in it, and Grok 4.6's own market says xAI lands inside it too.
